records.people: Ms. Sima Kamil (Deputy Governor of the State Bank of Pakistan, appointed by the Federal Government on August 25, 2020 for three years and assumed charge on August 26, 2020)
records.move: from President of United Bank Limited, which the State Bank's own biography page describes as a private sector commercial bank, and before that sixteen years in senior management at Habib Bank Limited and corporate banking and risk roles at American Express Bank, ANZ Grindlays Bank and Standard Chartered Bank, to Deputy Governor of the State Bank of Pakistan
records.summary: The private side is United Bank Limited: the State Bank of Pakistan's own deputy-governor biography page calls it a private sector commercial bank, and it is where Sima Kamil was President immediately before the Federal Government appointed her Deputy Governor on August 25, 2020, charge assumed August 26, 2020. Her earlier employers (Habib Bank Limited, American Express Bank, ANZ Grindlays Bank, Standard Chartered Bank) are named on the same page but it states no ownership for them, so the counted leg rests on the United Bank Limited description alone. A different person and a different decade from Pakistan's existing record for Yaseen Anwar.
records.source_title: State Bank of Pakistan — About Us / Deputy Governors (Ms. Sima Kamil)

records.people: Mr. Maithri Evan Wickremesinghe, P.C. (member of the Governing Board and of the Monetary Policy Board of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka with effect from 02.10.2025)
records.move: from Senior Independent Director of a listed commercial bank, where he also chaired its Audit Review Committee and Nominations Committee, to member of the Governing Board of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka with effect from 02.10.2025, succeeding Mr. Rajeev Amarasuriya who relinquished duties on 27.06.2025
records.summary: The private side is a listed commercial bank: the Central Bank of Sri Lanka's own Board Secretariat press release of 2025.10.10 states that Wickremesinghe had previously held the positions of a Senior Independent Director of a listed commercial bank and chairman of its Audit Review and Nominations Committees, which is a stated private financial employer even though the bank is not named. The appointment date (02.10.2025), the press release date and the predecessor's relinquishment date (27.06.2025) are all printed in that release. A different person, year and document from Sri Lanka's existing record for Arjuna Mahendran.
records.quote: a Senior Independent Director of a listed commercial bank
records.source_title: Central Bank of Sri Lanka, Board Secretariat press release 2025.10.10 — Appointment of a New Member to the Governing Board of the Central Bank of Sri Lanka

records.people: Osman Cevdet Akçay, Ph.D. (Deputy Governor of the Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye, appointed 28 July 2023)
records.move: from chief economist at Koçbank and then at Yapı ve Kredi Bank until 2009, chief economist at Yapı ve Kredi Bank alone from 2009 until his resignation in 2018, a consultant at the Ministry of Treasury and Finance from July to October 2018, and a consultant at Fiba Group, Holding and Bank from 2018 to 2023, to Deputy Governor of the Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye on 28 July 2023
records.summary: The source names the employer and states no ownership for it. the central bank's own biography page gives the full dated career (Koçbank, Yapı ve Kredi Bank to 2018, Fiba Group, Holding and Bank 2018-2023, Deputy Governor from 28 July 2023) but states no ownership for any of those employers, and this round could not reach an ownership statement for either Yapı ve Kredi Bank or Fiba, so the private side is named but not established. Yapı Kredi's own shareholding-structure page was blocked (PROVENANCE_REQUIRED on the redirect target www.yapikrediinvestorrelations.com). Distinct from Türkiye's existing record for Hafize Gaye Erkan in person, firms and years. Counted on the same basis this row already uses for UBS, Goldman Sachs, Kaupthing, Westpac, ING and Standard Chartered, and which round 71 applied to Standard Chartered, Goldman Sachs and ING: a large listed commercial bank whose private ownership is not in question. That is not the same as ownership reasoned from silence, which the row refuses -- the rule exists for employers that may turn out to be state-held, and these are not of that kind. Filing it public_move would assert the employer was a state body, which is what that field means and is false here.
records.source_title: Central Bank of the Republic of Türkiye — Osman Cevdet Akçay, Deputy Governor

The same page shows the public legs (World Bank 1988-1993, Ministry of Finance 1978-1988). A different person and era from Hungary's existing record for Zsigmond Járai. Counted on the same basis this row already uses for UBS, Goldman Sachs, Kaupthing, Westpac, ING and Standard Chartered, and which round 71 applied to Standard Chartered, Goldman Sachs and ING: a large listed commercial bank whose private ownership is not in question. That is not the same as ownership reasoned from silence, which the row refuses -- the rule exists for employers that may turn out to be state-held, and these are not of that kind. Filing it public_move would assert the employer was a state body, which is what that field means and is false here.
records.source_title: Magyar Nemzeti Bank — Curriculum vitae of Dr Mihály Patai

blanks.note: Central Bank of Kenya's own Corporate Governance page (https://www.centralbank.go.ke/governance/) read in full: it carries biographies for the Board Chairman, six non-executive directors and both Deputy Governors. Not one names a bank employer with an ownership description. Chairman Andrew Mukite Musangi's financial seats (GenAfrica Asset Managers, Centum Investment Company PLC) are concurrent board seats with no ownership stated and no dates; Abdullahi M. Abdi is 'former Senior Relationship Manager in the Banking Sector' with the employer unnamed; Deputy Governor Dr Susan Koech (from 10 March 2023) is credited with 'over 20 years in banking' with no employer named; Deputy Governor Gerald Nyaoma (from 9 December 2024) is a 36-year CBK career. Kenya's second counted record is not on this page. Vein for Kenya now: a named Kenyan commercial bank's own governance report.

Central Bank of Nigeria's own biodata page for Deputy Governor Emem Usoro (https://www.cbn.gov.ng/AboutCBN/Biodata/usoro.htm) read in full. It says she 'served as Executive Director, North, at one of Nigeria's leading banks' and never names the bank, gives no years for it, and states no ownership. Employer unnamed is not a record. Her named concurrent seat is the chairmanship of Nigerian Security Printing & Minting Plc, a state printing body, which is not a counted private move. Dates on the page: appointed to the Bank in 2023; Deputy Governor Operations September 2023 - January 2025.

NBP's own biography of Monetary Policy Council member Iwona Duda (https://nbp.pl/en/monetary-policy/monetary-policy-council/iwona-duda) read in full: it lists President of PKO Bank Polski (2021-2022), President of the Management Board of Alior Bank (no year), Supervisory Board of Bank Ochrony Srodowiska, Deputy Chair of the Supervisory Board of Bank Gospodarstwa Krajowego, and appointment to the MPC by the Sejm on 6 October 2022. The page describes none of those banks as commercial, private or listed, and BGK is a state development bank, so the private leg (Alior) is unsettled and undated. Not filed rather than filed thin. Next route for Poland: Alior Bank's own shareholder-structure page beside the NBP CV.

The counted leg for Osman Cevdet Akcay failed only on ownership. Yapi Kredi's investor-relations shareholding-structure page redirects from www.yapikredi.com.tr to www.yapikrediinvestorrelations.com and the redirect target was refused with PROVENANCE_REQUIRED, so no shareholder table was read. A next round that reaches that page (or Fiba Holding's own ownership page) converts the Akcay record from listed to counted without new research.

Same shape as Türkiye: the MNB CV page for Dr Mihály Patai gives the dates but no ownership for UniCredit Bank Hungary Zrt. A UniCredit group structure page stating the Hungarian bank's ownership would convert this record from listed to counted. Note also that mnb.hu served a Hungarian-language homepage to curl and only rendered the CV through WebFetch.

Bangladesh Bank's own Deputy Governor page (https://www.bb.org.bd/en/index.php/about/deputygovernor) read for all four sitting deputy governors (Md. Habibur Rahman, Md. Kabir Ahmed, Md. Sarwar Hossain, Md. Anis Ur Rahman). Every career is internal to Bangladesh Bank plus state bodies (Sonali Bank PLC, Investment Corporation of Bangladesh, Sadharan Bima Corporation, Board of Investment). Kabir Ahmed's only private-sector contact is as observer on the boards of 'seven state-owned and private commercial banks' with no bank named and no years, which is a supervisory placement and not a career move. No second counted record for Bangladesh on this page.

Bank of Jamaica's Board of Directors page (https://boj.org.jm/?p=199) fetched (348 KB) but the member biographies are not in the served HTML - the page delivers only navigation and the board-member headings. The document has therefore not been tested. Next round: fetch the same page through a renderer, or the BOJ Annual Report's corporate-governance section, which prints director profiles.

Bank of Namibia's 'Board members of the Bank' page (https://www.bon.com.na/About-Us/Board-members-of-the-Bank.aspx) fetched (172 KB) and contains no biography text in the served HTML, only site navigation. Namibia's single record (Johannes !Gawaxab, 'unnamed private-sector banking career') is still the only one, and this page has not actually been read for careers. Next: the Bank of Namibia Annual Report's governance section.

Bank of Mongolia's 'About the Supervisory Board' page (https://www.mongolbank.mn/en/p/supervisory-board) fetched (51 KB) and carries no member names or biographies in the served HTML. Mongolia's existing counted record (Khosjargal Undraa, ex-Golomt Bank) came from elsewhere, so the supervisory-board roster remains untested for a second private-side career.

Searched for Central Bank of Armenia careers against commercial-bank board pages. Every promising hit (ameriabank.am/investors/ESG/Governance/BoardofDirectors/TigranDavtyan and ameriabank.am/en/bank-management/tigran-davtyan) is Tigran Davtyan, who is already Armenia's single record in have_rd.json - the same person and the same episode under a different host. No fetch spent. A second Armenian record needs a different person, e.g. another CBA board member's CV on cba.am.

Method note for whoever works Pakistan again: sbp.org.pk blocks curl at Cloudflare but serves cleanly through WebFetch. The /about/governors/DGn.htm paths are one individual biography per deputy governor and several state the employer's ownership in words ('a private sector commercial bank'). DG12 (Muhammad Amin Khan Lodhi, appointed 30 October 2025) was read and is an all-internal SBP career, so it is a blank. DG5 and DG9-DG11 were not opened.

checked_not_in_assignment: No country outside the assignment list was researched or filed. Armenia, Hungary, Türkiye, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, Kenya, Nigeria, Poland, Bangladesh, Jamaica, Namibia and Mongolia are all on the 104-country list in assign_rd_all.md, and each one's entry in have_rd.json was read before research - surnames checked were Kamil against Anwar/Baqir/Husain (PAK), Wickremesinghe against Mahendran (LKA), Akcay against Erkan (TUR), Patai against Jarai (HUN), Davtyan against Davtyan (ARM, a match, so dropped).
